scripts.build: esbuild plugins/cairn/cli/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=plugins/cairn/dist/cairn.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test:mod: if ls plugins/cairn/hooks/test/*.test.ts* >/dev/null 2>&1; then d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R plugins/cairn/.claude-plugin plugins/cairn/hooks plugins/cairn/types "$d" && claude plugin test "$d"; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s; fi
